summary.en: Add the standalone Android offline companion source with native role/character selection, strategy choices, local saves and light/dark themes.
summary.zh: 纳入独立 Android 离线客户端源码，包含原生身份／人物选择、策略选项、本地存档和深浅主题。

compatibility.en: Desktop save schemas unchanged. Mobile retains application ID local.werewolf.probe; upgrades require the same signing key. Mobile and desktop saves remain separate. Source integration only, not a signed release.
compatibility.zh: 桌面存档格式不变。手机保留 local.werewolf.probe 应用 ID，升级需要同一签名；手机与桌面存档独立。本次仅合入源码，不发布签名版本。

reason: Document the new experimental mobile entry and portable build, scope and save boundaries in both languages.
